[3] Configure IAP Best Practices & Connect via IAP Tunnel

gcloud services enable iap.googleapis.com && gcloud compute firewall-rules create
Choose SSH mode for 'legacy-jumpbox-vm-01': [1] Direct SSH, [2] IAP Tunnel SSH, or [3] Configure IAP Best Practices.
